Home.intro: Personal colors, Hanbok styling, palace routes, local food and Korean culture — connected into one trip instead of six separate searches.
Home.context: Launching around Gyeongbokgung first. Free local discovery stays useful; credits unlock computation-heavy personalized features.
Home.modulesIntro: Each module can feed the next: color guidance can shape Hanbok choices, Hanbok can shape a photo route, and available time can shape food and nearby stops.
Home.travelerIntro: Your explicit choices always outrank market defaults. We do not infer nationality, ethnicity, religion or other sensitive identity traits from names, faces or language.
Home.freeText: Destinations, basic place browsing, cultural explainers and Quick Help stay accessible without buying credits.
Home.paidText: AI-heavy reports, visual generation and premium planning show a fixed credit cost before you confirm.
Home.internationalText: Language, route friction, food filters and practical travel information are localized without stereotyping individual travelers.

Culture.title: Explore traditions as culture, not certainty.
Culture.intro: Korean zodiac and Saju are presented as cultural and entertainment experiences. Birth details use separate consent and are not used for professional or high-impact advice.
Culture.zodiacText: A lightweight free cultural entry point.
Culture.sajuText: Birth time is optional. Exact time, a rough time band and ‘I don’t know’ are all valid paths; missing time is never guessed.
Culture.colorText: Traditional lucky-color storytelling stays clearly separate from personal-color styling guidance.
